skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Londinium Style Miko
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Londinium Style Miko. Home leisure style, standard apparel for Victorian housekeeping staff. The pattern on the skirt hem was embroidered in improvisation by Tsukinogi, who seems to have misunderstood this clothing's use case.
skins.quote: Serving gods and serving humans are far from as remote as you'd imagine.

skins.name: Dance
skins.content: Tsukinogi's formal dress for festive occasions/Dance. The flimsy red skirt and sturdy white shawl are like flowing fire and burning snow. Shall we dance?
skins.quote: No need to clean up. Avoiding the gift boxes on the ground is part of the fun of dancing. No need to learn the steps. The only dance Tsukinogi hates is the kind where every step is strictly choreographed.
